controls.title: Pre-push gate bypass via untracked worktree hook path
controls.remediationRule: Enforce strict hook path resolution in bin/idp-ci and commit genesis-defect-controls.json so isolated worktrees resolve the same registry.

controls.title: Unignored third-party vendor artifacts inflating argon-sync index (3,566 dirty entries)
controls.remediationRule: Lock .gitignore vendor exclusions and archive session blobs into ~/.estate/snapshots/ outside the git index.

controls.title: Cargo incremental build artifacts & Cargo.lock drift across 25 idp worktrees
controls.remediationRule: Route CARGO_TARGET_DIR to shared ~/.estate/cargo-target cache and prune 22 merged recovery worktrees.
